summary: India's GDP was USD 3,956,067,115,771.63 in 2025, up from USD 2,294,796,885,663.16 in 2016 despite a 2020 dip to USD 2,674,851,578,587.27. GDP per capita was USD 2,702.4799 and inflation was 2.3988% in 2025, with inflation falling from a 2022 peak of 6.699%. The INR/USD exchange rate was 0.010467 on 2026-09-11, a 0.448% decline, while the 10-year bond yield is unavailable (null).

India (IND) in Asia reported 2025 GDP of USD 3,956,067,115,771.63, 2025 GDP per capita of USD 2702.4799, and 2025 inflation of 2.3988%.
